cases.rationale: Outcome-selected harder supplement to b001-c05. The hidden major wolframite ZnWO4 is paired with balanced residual ZnO and WO3. All exact-composition entries, all one-substitution wolframite matches, all direct Zn-bearing wolframite solid solutions, and the loose FeWO4 COD 1567215 route discovered during b001 are withheld. The strict matcher reports tier-2 NbInO4 COD 1524100 as the nearest survivor (In->Zn and Nb->W, framework RMS 0.0106, 4.2% cell mismatch).

Outcome-selected harder secondary-adaptation supplement to b001-c06. Major wolframite MnWO4, 20 wt% hidden Mn3WO6 and compensating WO3 preserve global Mn:W = 1:1. The exact Mn3WO6 record and the tier-1 Mn3TeO6 analogue are withheld, leaving tier-2 Cd3TeO6 COD 2242674 (Cd->Mn and Te->W, framework RMS 0.0297, 5.68% cell mismatch). This tests whether two-site adaptation is pursued for a secondary phase after the principal phases already explain most peaks.
